notes.title: Slightly Updates On Replay Mode Today
notes.content:
Hi!

Thanks for purchasing Gear Puzzle and providing us your feedback. By the help from you, We make a slightly update version today.

In our newest version:

1. Fixed issues including replay mode.(Thanks for the feedback from gamers!)
2. Editing the description of the item and improve the gaming experience.

As we're still in the early access version, this game can't be perfect without your help. If you like the Gear Puzzle, you can send your feedback directly to us!

Our Email Address: com2p@outlook.com

Cheers!
[b]Gear Puzzle Team[/b]
